headline: China Pharma Sector Advances as Domestic Drugs Secure 80% of Approvals
summary: Chinese pharmaceutical companies are ramping up international expansion, with domestic innovative drugs accounting for 80% of all innovative medicine approvals in China over the first three quarters.
why: The rise of proprietary Chinese drug discovery challenges multinational pharmaceutical incumbents and drives biotech licensing agreements globally.

impacts.name: Chinese Pharmaceuticals
impacts.why: High approval rates for homegrown innovative drugs enhance sector revenue outlook ahead of quarterly earnings.
